ar.$description: Al Jazeera — the only Arabic typeface. ONE weight (400). Hierarchy by size, colour and space — never faux bold, italic, stretch or letter-spacing.

lat.$description: Schibsted Grotesk — Latin, numbers, URLs, phone. 400 text · 500 labels · 600 prominent numbers only.

display.$description: v1.1 (DS-27) — Thmanyah Serif Display for every large headline: cover titles, giant words, reel hooks, card titles, closing line. 500 sub · 700 titles · 900 giant words/hero numbers. Line-height >= 1.25. No glow/shadow/emboss. Al Jazeera stays the text face.
